title: (maintainability) The same per-renderer logic is written four times.
note: 11-18, part 1 of 4 written (rows/p022): the GPU's time by pass is one unit, galaxy/render/gpu_pass_times.h (one pass list for the four renderers, the billing of each interval between two timestamps, the page's averages and their clearing when timing stops, the logs' window, the benchmark's hook), tested by gpu_pass_times_tests.cpp; Direct3D 11 now clears its page averages when timing stops, as the others did. Part 2: the DXGI sync interval's choice is render_config.h dxgi_sync_interval for Direct3D 12 and 11, tested in render_config_tests.cpp. Left: the capture's encoding, the housekeeping at a frame's start.
